title: ‘A special sense of closeness’: China’s Xi vows stronger ties with North Korea in rare visit
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Monday said that China world not swerve from its commitment ​to safeguarding common interests with North Korea or waver in its support for Kim Jong Un during a rare summit between the two leaders in Pyongyang.
